item.tib: yang snying gsang ba'i thugs sgrub las sde brgyad kheng log bzlog mdos
item.coloph: ces kyi stag la phur shams can gyi las mthar sde brgyad bzlog bsgar gyi mdos 'di ni rgya rong brag steng dmar po ri gnas kyi gsang brag nas gsang sngags gling pas zab gter rin po che spyan drangs shing / las ldan gter grogs dbang mo mchog sprul yid bzhin sogs dar gling bla grwa thams cad brag steng rgyal sras ma yum bcas dang*/ ya ri bsod nams phun tshogs sogs kyi dad pas bskur (bskul) bzhin/ phyis su khro chen mtsho thog bla brang gi gzim chung du dag par phab ste/ yi ge pa ni mchog sprul g.yung drung bstan 'dzin gyis bgyis pa'o//
